decisions.reason: Colloid cyst case report; full text states endodermal vs tela choroidea neuroepithelium origins but never mentions the paraphysis.
Zebrafish multiciliated ependymal lineages/tela choroidea and CSF flow; no link to paraphysis region.
Cajal-Retzius/cortical hem markers in Xenopus pallium; lateral pallial patterning, not the roof midline or paraphysis.
Journal-history editorial; only cites Kunkel 1915 (paraphysis and pineal of garter snakes) in passing, no data itself (lead to the primary work).
Axolotl MRI atlas; paraphysis not mentioned or labelled as ROI.
Generic cortical hem/choroid plexus/hippocampus development review; never relates to the paraphysis region.
Turkey pineal gland development; no paraphysis content.
Review of vestigial human CNS structures; full abstract lists lamina terminalis remnants, suprapineal recess etc. but no paraphysis.
Sonographic normative data of third ventricle, commissural plate, cavum veli interpositi at 12-14 wk; does not locate or discuss the paraphysis.
Familial colloid cyst co-occurrence/genetics; no histogenesis or paraphysis data.
Hindbrain roof plate/choroid plexus history (His, Lmx1a); not telencephalic.
Trisomy 9p hydrocephalus case; incidental colloid cyst, no histogenesis.
Medial pallium subdomains (Prox1, Er81) in amphibian and turtle; hippocampal field homology, not the roof midline.

Original ventricular cast/micro-CT/dissection images of dogfish, bullfrog and iguana with paraphysis (pa), dorsal sac and velum transversum labelled; paraphysis shown as comparative gross-anatomy data (only figure keys seen, text unverified).
Generic choroid plexus development/function review; no paraphysis relation.

Comparative review of ventricular system development; excerpt (zebrafish CVOs/choroid plexus) does not show whether paraphysis/dorsal sac/velum transversum are treated; a text search of the full paper for paraphysis would resolve it.
Familial colloid cyst survey; clinical genetics, no histogenesis or paraphysis data.
Wnt signalling in choroid plexus epithelial fate; generic cortical hem/choroid plexus, no paraphysis link.
Intracranial ependymal cyst systematic review (GFAP criterion); not colloid cyst origin or paraphysis.
Histopathological series of 507 CNS epithelial cysts; full abstract has no colloid-cyst histogenesis or paraphysis discussion.
Teleost pineal histology; dorsal sac mentioned only as seat of pineal vesicle, no paraphysis.
Histological reinterpretation of paraphysis cerebri in axolotl larvae: two extraventricular evaginations (AEP = paraphysis, PEP = dorsal sac), diencephalic roof origin.
Zebrafish telencephalon transgene atlas; full text lacks paraphysis, dorsal sac or velum transversum.
Colloid cyst case with hyphal-like structures; standard histology only, no origin discussion.
Chick pineal embryonic histomorphometry; no paraphysis content.
Fetal suprapineal pseudocyst in spina bifida (posterior tela choroidea); not the paraphysis territory.

Case plus review explicitly states colloid cysts were thought to arise from the paraphysis cerebri and that immunohistochemistry (ciliated, goblet, basal cells) argues for endodermal rather than paraphyseal origin; secondary statement, no own data.
Acute hydrocephalus case; only asserts endodermal origin, paraphysis not named.
Case plus review; origin paragraph mentions diencephalic-roof pouch theory but never names the paraphysis.
Choroid plexus cyst systematic review; clinical, no paraphysis or colloid cyst histogenesis.
Teleost telencephalic eversion; tela choroidea covering dorsal telencephalon, no paraphysis/dorsal sac link.
Chick SCO transcriptome as embryonic CSF source; SCO paper not comparing itself with the paraphysis.
Tubular retractor surgical series; introduction only states primitive neuroepithelium folding origin, no paraphysis.
Teleost telencephalon spatial cell atlas; full text lacks paraphysis, velum transversum, dorsal sac.
Zebrafish choroid plexus homeostasis; generic choroid plexus, no paraphysis link.
Lungfish 3D MRI atlas; full text never mentions paraphysis or dorsal sac.
LMX1A forced expression in hESC midbrain differentiation; roof plate fates in vitro, no paraphysis link.
First-trimester sonographic cavum veli interpositi prevalence; does not address the paraphysis.
Radiation-induced cortical hem/choroid plexus-like changes in organoids; no paraphysis.
Colloid cyst series with own CK/S100/PAX7 immunohistochemistry vs ependyma and choroid plexus; authors interpret PAX7 staining as a paraphysis remnant.
Autopsy series of sudden deaths from colloid cysts; no histogenesis or paraphysis discussion.
Operative case; only repeats that many authors support endodermal origin, paraphysis not named.
SOX2/LMX1 in hindbrain choroid plexus tumours and development; no paraphysis link.

Embryology chapter on ventricular system and colloid cysts proposing origin from detached diencephalic recesses or paraphysis cerebri remnants with endodermal trapping; chapter text not read (snippet only).
MRI growth charts of lateral ventricle choroid plexus across lifespan; no paraphysis.
Pax6/Pax7 in cladistian fish CNS; full abstract has no paraphysis or telencephalic roof content (Pax7 absent in telencephalon).
